key_insight: Encoding rotational symmetry directly into a spherical CNN reduces the need to learn it from simulations, improving data efficiency for scientific inference.
engineering_relevance: For scientific data on the sphere with no preferred orientation, this architecture can make better use of costly simulations for prediction and inference.
method: Build a gauge-equivariant mesh CNN tailored to HEALPix spherical grids.
Combine steerable filters, parallel transport, and spin-weighted features.
Construct SO(3)-equivariant convolutions with exactness guarantees under a band-limit.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports the most accurate dense gradient regression, competitive CMB foreground removal and denoising, and the tightest cosmological lensing posteriors at matched simulation counts.
watch_item: Exact equivariance is conditional on a band-limit; full-network invariance remains approximate, with errors controlled by hyperparameter choices.
paper_title: Learning without relearning physical symmetry: an SO(3)-equivariant convolutional network (CNN) on the sphere
